title: Crockpot Rib Eye with Au Jus and Mushrooms
ingredients: Salt to taste (use sparingly — au jus packets are salty)
instructions: Place rib eye steak in the crockpot.
Add minced garlic and sliced mushrooms on top of and around the steak.
Whisk both au jus seasoning packets into the beef broth until dissolved.
Pour the au jus mixture over the steak.
Cover and cook on LOW for 5 hours until the meat is tender.
Serve with the au jus from the crockpot for dipping or drizzling.
notes: Recipe by @cayleyxo. Shared via Facebook reel by Dustin Hadley. Tips from commenters: skip extra salt or use low-sodium broth since au jus packets are already salty. Optional additions: celery, baby carrots, onions. Can brown meat first in a skillet for better flavor and texture. Silicone crockpot liners make cleanup easy. Some commenters likened this to a Sunday pot roast or beef stew.
